notes: Page title 'Healthy Breakfast'. Branded 'kaloreez' (green circular logo with veg/fruit icons, tagline 'A blend of taste, health and hygiene' - tagline tiny, uncertain) top-right, NOT 'Gluttons Garage' - likely a sister/partner brand menu. Design: cream/beige parchment background with faint gear/cog pattern; headings in dark brown decorative calligraphic display font (Aniron/medieval-style); item names bold dark brown serif, descriptions brown condensed sans; prices format 'NN/-' (no rupee symbol). Green circular markers before each item (veg). Items carry a printed nutrition table (columns: kCal | Fat (g) | Carb(g) | Protein(g)); captured per item in an extra 'nutrition' field. Bottom third is a food photo (ragi malt/chocolate porridge swirl in white bowl, milk jug, checked cloth). No tax/service-charge text visible. Legibility good.
